addressAskedUntilApproved: Asked {date}. Until they approve it, customers see your salon at {addressLine}, {area} and can book as usual. Change it below, or:
addressDeclined: Your last request ({addressLine}) wasn't approved: “{reason}” Your address stays as it was; you can send a new one below.
addressDeclinedList: Your last request ({addressLine}) wasn't approved. Your address stays as it was; you can send a new one below.
closeReasonTooShort: Write at least 2 characters, or leave it empty
noLongerOwnerOfNamed: You're no longer the owner of {name}: it was handed over or closed already.
closeShopChanged: Your shop changed a moment ago (on another phone, or by the field team). It has been read again: check and try again.
closeNoLongerOwner: You're no longer the owner of this shop (it was handed over or closed already).
closeForGoodWarning: Closing is for good. It can't be undone.
closeEffectBookings: Every upcoming online booking is cancelled, and each customer is told the salon has closed.
closeEffectTeam: Your helpers and barbers lose access at once.
closeEffectYou: You leave the shop too. Customers can no longer find it.
closeEffectComeBack: To come back later, you register a new shop: a new field visit and a new shop code.
closeHandOverBefore: Want someone else to run it instead?
closeHandOverAfter: keeps its bookings, team and listing.
closeUnderstand: I understand that {name} closes for good and its upcoming bookings are cancelled.
editOnUntil: Editing is on until {time} ({minutes} min left)
editNeedsCodeEnding: Your salon is verified: this needs a code we send to your phone.
editNeedsCodeEndingKirana: Your shop is verified: this needs a code we send to your phone.
editNeedsCode: Your salon is verified: changes need a code we send to your phone.
editNeedsCodeKirana: Your shop is verified: changes need a code we send to your phone.
editCodeExplainEnding: Your salon is verified, so we check it's you first. One code to +91 {phone} confirms it on this phone for 15 minutes.
editCodeExplainEndingKirana: Your shop is verified, so we check it's you first. One code to +91 {phone} confirms it on this phone for 15 minutes.
editCodeExplain: Your salon is verified, so we check it's you first. One code to +91 {phone} lets you change everything on this phone for 15 minutes.
editCodeExplainKirana: Your shop is verified, so we check it's you first. One code to +91 {phone} lets you change everything on this phone for 15 minutes.
editCodeSentWait: Sent. You can send again after 30 seconds
handoverPhoneOwn: That's your own number. Enter the number of the person who'll take over.
handoverShopChanged: Your shop changed a moment ago. It has been read again: send the request again.
handoverNoLongerOwner: You're no longer the owner of this shop.
handoverIntro: Give {name} to someone else, such as a new owner or a family member. They see your request when they sign in to Clozest Partner with their number. When they accept, they become the owner and you leave the shop (you're signed out of it). Its details, photos, bookings and team stay as they are.
handoverRunsOut: It runs out on {date} if they don't answer.
offersNoneBody: When a shop owner asks you to take over their shop, it shows here.
offerOwnerNotRenewed: You're the owner now, but this phone couldn't renew its sign-in. Check the connection and tap Try again.
offerNotOpenForNumber: This request isn't open for your number any more.
offerFinishProfile: Finish your profile (a verified email and your name) first.
leaveShopFromMore: You can leave {name} from the “You” tab.
offerBody: {ownerName}, the owner of {shopName} (shop code {shopCode}, {area}, {city}), wants to hand the shop over to you.
offerBecomeOwnerBody: You become its owner: its details, photos, bookings and team are yours to run. {ownerName} leaves the shop. Check the owner's name and photo afterwards (a new photo means our team checks the shop again).
offerBecomeOwnerBodySameShop: You become its owner: its details, photos, bookings and team are yours to run. {ownerName} leaves the shop. You stay in it, as the owner now. Check the owner's name and photo afterwards (a new photo means our team checks the shop again).
notLiveRegisteredBody: {ownerName} has registered {name}. Once our field team approves it, you'll see the day's bookings here.
notLiveRegisteredBodyKirana: {ownerName} has registered {name}. Once our field team approves it, you'll bill at the counter here.
notLiveRegisteringBody: {ownerName} is still registering {name}. Once our field team approves it, you'll see the day's bookings here.
notLiveRegisteringBodyKirana: {ownerName} is still registering {name}. Once our field team approves it, you'll bill at the counter here.
visitNextBody: We'll call you to fix a time, visit {name} and switch it on. Customers can book once it's approved.
visitNextBodyKirana: We'll call you to fix a time, visit {name} and switch it on. Nearby customers can order once it’s approved; your counter works already.
quoteShopCode: Quote it when you talk to us.
inviteGoneExpired: This invitation ran out (invitations last 7 days). Ask the owner to invite you again.
inviteGoneStaffChanged: The owner changed that barber profile meanwhile. Ask them to invite you again.
inviteGoneOther: This invitation isn't open any more.
invitesNoneBody: When a shop owner invites your number, it shows here.
inviteJoinedNotRenewed: You've joined, but this phone couldn't renew its sign-in. Check the connection and tap Try again.
inviteDeclined: You declined the invitation from {shopName}. The owner has been told.
inviteNotOpenForNumber: This invitation isn't open for your number any more.
inviteBodyBarber: {shopName} (shop code {shopCode}, {area}, {city}) invited you to join as a barber. You will see your own bookings and add your breaks.
inviteBodyHelper: {shopName} (shop code {shopCode}, {area}, {city}) invited you to join as a helper. You will help run the day: walk-ins, starting bookings, breaks.
recheckFixAsked: Our field team asked you to fix something
recheckCheckingSince: Our field team is checking your changes since {date}
recheckFixWhere: “{fix}” Fix it in the Salon tab → Salon details or Photos and video (for the address: Salon details → Request address change).
recheckFixWhereList: Fix it in the Salon tab → Salon details or Photos and video (for the address: Salon details → Request address change).
recheckFixWhereKirana: “{fix}” Fix it in “You” → Edit (shop details), Photos or UPI ID (for the address: Request address change).
recheckFixWhereListKirana: Fix it in “You” → Edit (shop details), Photos or UPI ID (for the address: Request address change).
recheckStaysLive: Your salon stays live and customers can book as usual.
recheckStaysOpenKirana: Your shop stays open and customers can order as usual.
docPickPhotoOrPdf: Pick a photo or a PDF of your trade licence.
docPdfTooBig: This PDF is bigger than 10 MB. Take a photo of the licence instead.
licenceReasonUnreadable: We couldn’t read it. Take a clear, well-lit photo of the whole licence, or upload the PDF.
licenceReasonNotTradeLicence: It isn’t a municipal trade licence. Upload your trade licence from GHMC or your municipality.
licenceReasonLooksEdited: It looks edited. Upload the licence exactly as you got it.
licenceReasonNoNumber: We couldn’t find the licence number on it. Make sure the whole licence is in the photo.
licenceReasonNotASalonTrade: It is a licence for another kind of business, not a salon.
licenceReasonNoValidity: We couldn’t find until when it is valid. Make sure the dates are in the photo.
licenceReasonExpired: It has expired. Upload the renewed licence.
licenceReasonNameMismatch: The name on it doesn’t match your salon’s name or the owner’s name. If your details are wrong, change them in Salon details: the licence is checked again by itself.
licenceReasonAddressMismatchLocked: The address on it doesn’t match your salon’s address. If your address is wrong, ask our field team to change it (Salon details → Request address change): once they do, the licence is checked again by itself.
licenceReasonAddressMismatch: The address on it doesn’t match your salon’s address. If your address is wrong, change it in Salon details: the licence is checked again by itself.
licenceReasonDuplicate: This licence is already used by another salon. If it is yours, write to support and we’ll sort it out.
licenceReasonNotRead: We couldn’t read it. Try a clearer photo, or the PDF.
licenceReasonNotAShopTrade: It is for another kind of business, not a grocery or general store.
licenceReasonNotShopsEstablishment: It isn’t a Shops and Establishments certificate. If it is your trade licence, choose Trade licence and upload it again.
licenceReasonOther: Upload another photo or the PDF of your trade licence.
licenceSummaryNotAccepted: Not accepted: open to see why
licenceSummaryOldKind: Only a trade licence counts now: add yours
licenceCheckingSlow: Checking your trade licence is taking longer than usual. We’ll send you a message when it’s done; nothing else about your salon changes meanwhile.
licenceChecking: Checking your trade licence. This usually takes under a minute; you can leave this page.
licenceStatusLicensed: Checked: customers see "Licensed" on your salon until {date}.
licenceStatusExpired: Your trade licence expired on {date}: customers no longer see "Licensed". Upload the renewed licence.
licenceOldKindShops: Only a municipal trade licence counts now. Replace your shops and establishments certificate with your trade licence to show "Licensed".
licenceOldKindUdyam: Only a municipal trade licence counts now. Replace your udyam certificate with your trade licence to show "Licensed".
licenceCardIntro: Add a photo or PDF of your salon’s trade licence (GHMC, Cyberabad, Malkajgiri or your municipality) and get "Licensed" on your salon. We check it automatically against your salon’s name and address. No licence? Your salon stays open as it is, with no badge.
licenceTakePhotoOrPdf: Take a photo or choose a PDF
licenceLeaveWarning: The licence is still uploading. Leave anyway? It may not be saved.
licenceNoneNote: No trade licence added: your salon shows no "Licensed" badge. It stays open for bookings either way.
licenceRemoveAsk: Remove the trade licence? Customers will no longer see "Licensed" on your salon. Your salon stays open for bookings.
videoLeaveWarning: The salon video is still uploading. Leave anyway? It will have to be sent again.
videoLeaveWarningKirana: The shop video is still uploading. Leave anyway? It will have to be sent again.
videoUploadCancelled: Upload cancelled. Tap Try again to send it, or pick another video.
videoLengthNote: {min}–{max} seconds. Only our field team sees it, before the visit.
videoHowSideways: Hold the phone sideways. If your camera is set to 4K, switch it to 1080p (HD) first.
videoHowOutside: Start outside: show the board with the salon's name and the entrance (about 5 seconds).
videoHowOutsideKirana: Start outside: show the board with the shop's name and the entrance (about 5 seconds).
videoHowInside: Walk in, stand near the door, turn slowly from left to right showing the chairs, mirrors and waiting area.
videoHowInsideKirana: Walk in, stand near the counter, turn slowly from left to right showing the shelves and the counter.
videoHowSteady: Lights on, keep the phone steady, no need to talk.
videoHowFaces: Avoid customers' faces where you can.
videoCantPlay: Couldn't play the video. Reload the page.
videoTooBig: This video is too big. Set the camera to 1080p (HD) and record about 30 seconds.
videoLengthUnknown: We couldn't read this video's length. Make sure it's {min}–{max} seconds.
videoShopChangedAgain: Your salon was changed on another phone. Reload the page, then add the video again.
videoShopChangedAgainKirana: Your shop was changed on another phone. Reload the page, then add the video again.
videoOwnerOnlyKirana: Only the shop owner can add the shop video.
videoPickVideo: Pick a video (MP4, MOV or WebM).
videoTooShort: This video is {seconds} seconds. Record at least {min} seconds: start outside at the board, then walk in and turn slowly.
videoTooLong: This video is {seconds} seconds. Keep it under {max} seconds — about 30 is ideal.
videoUploadTooLong: The upload took too long. Tap Try again.
videoDidntGoThrough: The video didn't go through. Tap Try again.
videoSomethingWrong: Something went wrong. Tap Try again.
videoOffline: The upload stopped: you're offline or the network dropped. Tap Try again.
videoKeepBetween: Keep the video between {min} and {max} seconds — about 30 is ideal.
videoNotUsable: That file isn't a video we can use. Record it again with the phone's camera.
videoNotWhole: The video didn't arrive whole. Tap Try again.
videoUploadTooLongAgain: The upload took too long. Tap Try again to send it again.
videoExpired: This video expired. Upload it again.
handoverRequestSent: Request sent. If that number has a Clozest account, they'll see it when they open the app.
leaveShopBelow: You can leave {name} with the button below.
notCalledYet: Not called yet? Call us or WhatsApp us, with your shop code.
